description: This file defines an interface 'ISlowConsumingGrain' within the namespace 'UnitTests.GrainInterfaces'. The interface extends 'IGrainWithGuidKey' and declares methods related to stream consumption, including starting, stopping, and retrieving the number of items consumed.

classes.name: ISlowConsumingGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that consumes streams slowly, providing methods to start consumption, stop it, and get the count of consumed items.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Initiates the grain to become a consumer for the specified stream, identified by streamId and streamNamespace, using the specified provider.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Stops the grain from consuming streams.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the total number of stream items consumed.
